skill.name: invalid-governance-skill
skill.description: Governance validation fixture for testing skill metadata rules.
skill.summary: Minimal fixture for testing skill governance validation.
skill.author: yaojingang

security_audit.summary: The static system reconnaissance finding is a false positive. SKILL.md line 6 is only a Markdown heading, and the surrounding text describes a governance validation fixture.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 6 is only a Markdown heading for the fixture. I found no system reconnaissance instructions, commands, or data collection behavior in the skill text.

content.value_statement: Teams need compact examples for validating skill governance checks. This fixture provides a minimal skill and manifest for testing policy enforcement.
actual_capabilities: Provides a minimal SKILL.md with skill name and description metadata.
Includes a manifest with governance fields for validation workflows.
Represents an intentionally invalid governance fixture for test coverage.
Supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatibility metadata.
Offers a small two-file sample for audit pipeline checks.
limitations: Does not implement an operational assistant workflow.
Does not validate manifests or repair metadata automatically.
Contains fixture metadata that may fail governance checks by design.
Provides no scripts, integrations, network access, or automation.

use_cases.title: Validate Marketplace Checks
use_cases.description: Use the fixture to confirm that governance validation detects invalid metadata cases.

use_cases.title: Build Regression Tests
use_cases.description: Add the fixture to automated suites that protect policy checks from regressions.

use_cases.title: Document Invalid Metadata
use_cases.description: Reference the fixture when explaining how governance rules reject malformed skill packages.

output_examples.input: Summarize this fixture for a reviewer.
output_examples.output: This is a compact governance validation fixture. It is useful for testing metadata policy enforcement, not for production workflows.

output_examples.input: Explain how a test suite could use this skill.
output_examples.output: A test suite can load the fixture, run governance validation, and confirm that expected metadata failures are reported.
Use it only in audit, documentation, or validation tests. Do not publish it as a production assistant skill.

best_practices: Use this fixture only in validation or review test contexts.
Document expected governance failures in the related test plan.
Pair the fixture with schema validation for complete governance coverage.
anti_patterns: Do not publish this fixture as a production workflow skill.
Do not treat the fixture as a standalone manifest validator.
Do not remove intentionally invalid metadata without updating related tests.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It is a small fixture for testing marketplace governance validation.

faq.question: Does it perform any automation?
faq.answer: No. It only provides metadata and documentation for validation tests.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it intended for production users?
faq.answer: No. It is intended for reviewers, platform engineers, and documentation teams.

faq.question: Why is the fixture called invalid?
faq.answer: The name signals that it is designed to exercise governance failure handling.

faq.question: Does it include risky scripts or network calls?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed files contain no scripts, network calls, or command execution.
